description: Disfluencies the polish profile must remove: fillers (um, uh, like, euh, bah), self-corrections ('three retries no wait five' → five), repeated words, and abandoned clauses. forbiddenSubstrings carry the disfluency; requiredTokens the surviving content.

cases.spokenForm: run the tests with dash dash filter um equals auth
cases.notes: Field-observed verbatim; ASR once heard 'equal on' for 'equals'.

cases.spokenForm: set it to three retries no wait five
cases.notes: Numeric self-correction: the last value wins.

cases.spokenForm: uh can you check why the build cache is stale
cases.intendedText: Can you check why the build cache is stale?

cases.spokenForm: the parser is like dropping the last token sometimes
cases.intendedText: The parser is dropping the last token sometimes.

cases.spokenForm: the overlay you know flickers when the session ends
cases.intendedText: The overlay flickers when the session ends.
cases.notes: Two-word filler splitting subject and verb.

cases.spokenForm: open user manager no sorry user session manager dot swift
cases.notes: Self-corrected filename; the abandoned name must not survive.

cases.spokenForm: point it at port eight thousand actually eight thousand eighty
cases.notes: Corrected port: symbol transform AND correction must compose.

cases.spokenForm: rename the branch to fix slash overlay i mean feature slash overlay
cases.notes: Corrected branch name with slash dictation.

cases.spokenForm: add the dash dash um verbose flag to the command
cases.intendedText: Add the --verbose flag to the command.
cases.notes: Filler lands INSIDE a spoken flag — transform must bridge it.

cases.intendedText: Rename the cache directory to cache.bak.
cases.notes: Whole-clause retraction: the first instruction must vanish.

cases.intendedText: Run the linter before you commit.
